body_html:
Where we are

Point Face Ungasan is at Jl. Toya Ning II No. 99, Ungasan, Kuta Selatan. It is a convenient stop if you are staying in Ungasan, Kutuh, around Melasti or Pandawa beaches, or coming up from Jimbaran and Nusa Dua. Open Mon–Sat 10:00–19:00, Sun 12:00–19:00.

What makes Point Face Ungasan different

  • Exclusive Korean HydroJelly facials: Caviar Luxury Anti-Aging & Lift (70 min, IDR 1,500K), Bright & Pigment Correct (60 min, IDR 1,100K) and Cryo Skin Reset (60 min, IDR 1,050K) are only available here.
  • The full Korean Hydrafacial menu: our glass skin facial (Ultimate Korean Glass Skin & Hydralift, 80 min, IDR 1,300K), PDRN Cellular Repair, Advanced Collagen Booster, K-Balance Acne Clear and Vitamin C Sunshine Glow.
  • Face massages: Kobido, Gua Sha, Buccal and our Relaxation Ritual.
  • Balinese rituals: Rose & Aloe and Clay & Turmeric, made with Utama Spice products.
  • A K-beauty corner with COSRX, SKIN1004, Beauty of Joseon, Medicube and natural Utama Spice products.

Which facial to book in Ungasan

Your skin goal Our recommendation
Glass skin glow before an event Ultimate Korean Glass Skin & Hydralift
Firmness and lift Caviar Luxury Anti-Aging & Lift (Ungasan only)
Sun spots, uneven tone Bright & Pigment Correct (Ungasan only) or Vitamin C Sunshine Glow
Hot, red, sun-stressed skin Cryo Skin Reset (Ungasan only)
Blackheads and breakouts K-Balance Acne Clear

Every treatment starts with a complimentary skin analysis, and all prices include 15% tax and service charge.

Ungasan or Bingin?

Both studios share the same Korean Hydrafacials, face massages and Balinese rituals. Choose Ungasan for the exclusive HydroJelly facials, and Bingin for our body treatments (back, chest and glutes) near Bingin and Padang Padang beaches.
